<h3 id="具体实现可参考netcorekevin中的kevinentityframeworkcore下的savechangeswithsavelog方法">具体实现可参考NetCoreKevin中的Kevin.EntityFrameworkCore下的SaveChangesWithSaveLog方法</h3>
<p>一个基于NET8搭建DDD-微服务-现代化Saas企业级WebAPI前后端分离架构：前端Vue3、IDS4单点登录、多级缓存、自动任务、分布式、AI智能体、一库多租户、日志、授权和鉴权、CAP事件、SignalR、领域事件、MCP协议服务、IOC模块化注入、Cors、Quartz自动任务、多短信、AI、AgentFramework、SemanticKernel集成、RAG检索增强+Qdrant矢量数据库、OCR识别、API多版本、单元测试、RabbitMQ</p>
<p>项目地址：github：<a href="https://github.com/junkai-li/NetCoreKevin" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/junkai-li/NetCoreKevin</a><br>
Gitee: <a href="https://gitee.com/netkevin-li/NetCoreKevin" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/netkevin-li/NetCoreKevin</a></p>
<h3 id="技术文章大纲在net项目的efcore中实现敏感数据变动日志">技术文章大纲：在.NET项目的EFCore中实现敏感数据变动日志</h3>
<h4 id="核心目标">核心目标</h4>
<ul>
<li>记录关键字段（如密码、金额、权限等）的变更历史</li>
<li>确保日志可追溯且不可篡改</li>
<li>平衡性能与安全性需求</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="技术实现方案">技术实现方案</h4>
<p><strong>拦截数据变更</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>重写<code>SaveChanges</code>或<code>SaveChangesAsync</code>方法</li>
<li>利用<code>ChangeTracker</code>获取变更的实体状态</li>
<li>筛选标记为敏感字段的属性变更</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>自定义日志模型设计</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">    public partial class TOSLog : CD
    {
        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        /// 外链表名
        /// &lt;/summary&gt;
        [StringLength(50)]
        [Description("外链表名")]
        public string? Table { get; set; }



        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        /// 外链表ID
        /// &lt;/summary&gt;
        [Description("外链表ID")]
        public Guid TableId { get; set; }



        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        /// 标记
        /// &lt;/summary&gt;
        [StringLength(100)]
        [Description("标记")]
        public string? Sign { get; set; }



        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        /// 变动内容
        /// &lt;/summary&gt; 
        [Description("变动内容")]
        public string? Content { get; set; }



        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        /// 操作人信息
        /// &lt;/summary&gt;
        [Description("操作人信息")]
        public Guid? ActionUserId { get; set; }
        public virtual TUser? ActionUser { get; set; }



        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        /// 备注
        /// &lt;/summary&gt; 
        [Description("备注")]
        public string? Remarks { get; set; }



        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        /// Ip地址
        /// &lt;/summary&gt;
        [StringLength(100)]
        [Description("Ip地址")]
        public string? IpAddress { get; set; }



        /// &lt;summary&gt;
        ///  设备标记
        /// &lt;/summary&gt; 
        [Description("设备标记")]
        public string? DeviceMark { get; set; }
    }
</code></pre>
<p><strong>敏感数据脱敏处理</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>对密码等字段采用哈希存储</li>
<li>金额类字段保留变更差值</li>
<li>使用<code>[SensitiveData]</code>自定义属性标记敏感字段</li>
</ul>
<p>*<em>核心代码数据变化比较</em></p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">        ///// &lt;summary&gt;
       ///// 数据变化比较
       ///// &lt;/summary&gt;
       ///// &lt;typeparam name="T"&gt;&lt;/typeparam&gt;
       ///// &lt;param name="original"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
       ///// &lt;param name="after"&gt;&lt;/param&gt;
       ///// &lt;returns&gt;&lt;/returns&gt;
       public string ComparisonEntity&lt;T&gt;(T original, T after) where T : new()
       {
           var retValue = "";

           var fields = typeof(T).GetProperties();

           var baseTypeNames = new List&lt;string&gt;();
           var baseType = original.GetType().BaseType;
           while (baseType != null)
           {
               baseTypeNames.Add(baseType.FullName);
               baseType = baseType.BaseType;
           }

           for (int i = 0; i &lt; fields.Length; i++)
           {
               var pi = fields[i];

               string oldValue = pi.GetValue(original)?.ToString();
               string newValue = pi.GetValue(after)?.ToString();

               string typename = pi.PropertyType.FullName;

               if ((typename != "System.Decimal" &amp;&amp; oldValue != newValue) || (typename == "System.Decimal" &amp;&amp; decimal.Parse(oldValue) != decimal.Parse(newValue)))
               {
                   var descriptionAttr = pi.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(DescriptionAttribute), true);
                   if (descriptionAttr.Length &gt; 0)
                   {
                       retValue += ((DescriptionAttribute)descriptionAttr[0]).Description + ":";
                   }
                   else
                   {
                       retValue += pi.Name + ":";
                   }

                   if (pi.Name != "Id" &amp; pi.Name.EndsWith("Id"))
                   {
                       var foreignTable = fields.FirstOrDefault(t =&gt; t.Name == pi.Name.Replace("Id", ""));

                       using var db = new KevinDbContext();

                       var foreignName = foreignTable.PropertyType.GetProperties().Where(t =&gt; t.CustomAttributes.Where(c =&gt; c.AttributeType.Name == "ForeignNameAttribute").Count() &gt; 0).FirstOrDefault();

                       if (foreignName != null)
                       {

                           if (oldValue != null)
                           {
                               var oldForeignInfo = db.Find(foreignTable.PropertyType, Guid.Parse(oldValue));
                               oldValue = foreignName.GetValue(oldForeignInfo).ToString();
                           }

                           if (newValue != null)
                           {
                               var newForeignInfo = db.Find(foreignTable.PropertyType, Guid.Parse(newValue));
                               newValue = foreignName.GetValue(newForeignInfo).ToString();
                           }

                       }

                       retValue += (oldValue ?? "") + " -&gt; ";
                       retValue += (newValue ?? "") + "； \n";

                   }
                   else if (typename == "System.Boolean")
                   {
                       retValue += (oldValue != null ? (bool.Parse(oldValue) ? "是" : "否") : "") + " -&gt; ";
                       retValue += (newValue != null ? (bool.Parse(newValue) ? "是" : "否") : "") + "； \n";
                   }
                   else if (typename == "System.DateTime")
                   {
                       retValue += (oldValue != null ? DateTime.Parse(oldValue).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") : "") + " -&gt;";
                       retValue += (newValue != null ? DateTime.Parse(newValue).ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") : "") + "； \n";
                   }
                   else
                   {
                       retValue += (oldValue ?? "") + " -&gt; ";
                       retValue += (newValue ?? "") + "； \n";
                   }

               }



           }

           return retValue;
       }
</code></pre>
<p><strong>核心代码重写SaveChanges</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp"> KevinDbContext db = this;

 var list = db.ChangeTracker.Entries().Where(t =&gt; t.State == EntityState.Modified).ToList();
 foreach (var item in list)
 {
     #region 更改值时处理乐观并发
     item.Entity.GetType().GetProperty("RowVersion")?.SetValue(item.Entity, Guid.NewGuid());
     #endregion

     var type = item.Entity.GetType(); 
     var oldEntity = item.OriginalValues.ToObject(); 
     var newEntity = item.CurrentValues.ToObject(); 
     var entityId = item.CurrentValues.GetValue&lt;Guid&gt;("Id");   
     object[] parameters = { oldEntity, newEntity }; 
     var result = new KevinDbContext().GetType().GetMethod("ComparisonEntity").MakeGenericMethod(type).Invoke(new KevinDbContext(), parameters); 
     var osLog = new TOSLog();
     osLog.Id = Guid.NewGuid();
     osLog.CreateTime = DateTime.Now;
     osLog.Table = type.Name;
     osLog.TableId = entityId;
     osLog.Sign = "Modified";
     osLog.Content = result.ToString();
     osLog.IpAddress = HttpContextAccessor.GetIpAddress();
     osLog.DeviceMark = HttpContextAccessor.GetDevice();
     osLog.ActionUserId = CurrentUser.UserId;
     osLog.TenantId = TenantId;
     db.Set&lt;TOSLog&gt;().Add(osLog);
 }

 #region 新增处理多租户

 var Addedlist = db.ChangeTracker.Entries().Where(t =&gt; t.State == EntityState.Added).ToList();
 foreach (var item in Addedlist)
 {
     item.Entity.GetType().GetProperty("TenantId")?.SetValue(item.Entity, TenantId);
 }

 #endregion
 return base.SaveChanges();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="高级优化策略">高级优化策略</h4>
<p><strong>异步日志写入</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>通过<code>Task.Run</code>实现非阻塞写入</li>
<li>考虑使用内存队列缓冲日志</li>
<li>设置合理的重试机制</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>性能监控</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>记录日志写入耗时</li>
<li>配置日志表索引优化查询</li>
<li>定期归档历史日志</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="安全增强措施">安全增强措施</h4>
<p><strong>日志加密存储</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>对敏感字段采用AES加密</li>
<li>实现日志签名防篡改</li>
<li>设置最小化访问权限</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>合规性检查</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>GDPR等法规要求处理</li>
<li>设置合理的日志保留周期</li>
<li>提供日志清理接口</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="扩展应用场景">扩展应用场景</h4>
<p><strong>实时告警机制</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>关键字段变更触发通知</li>
<li>可疑操作模式检测</li>
<li>与SIEM系统集成</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>版本回溯功能</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>基于日志恢复历史状态</li>
<li>可视化变更对比</li>
<li>操作回滚接口设计</li>
</ul>
